records.jp: ここが目的地、だよね……
records.en_original: This must be it...
records.en: This must be it...

records.jp: ――ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: ...Hina.
records.en: ...Hina-chan.

records.jp: またあの声だ！　ってことは……
records.en_original: It's that voice again! Which means...
records.en: It's that voice again! Which means...

records.jp: ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: Hina.
records.en: Hina-chan.

records.jp: 記憶の再生が始まるのかな……？
records.en_original: Is the memory starting...?
records.en: Is the memory starting...?

records.jp: ううん、違うよ
records.en_original: No.
records.en: No.

records.en_original: ...Huh?
records.en: ...Huh?

records.jp: これは、ヒナちゃんの記憶じゃない
records.en_original: This isn't a memory of Hina's.
records.en: This isn't a memory of Hina-chan's.

records.jp: ちょ、待って！？　どういうこと……？？？
records.en_original: Wait, what?! What do you mean?
records.en: Wait, what?! What do you mean?

records.jp: なんで――――こっちに話しかけてきてるの？
records.en_original: Why are they speaking to us?
records.en: Why are they speaking to us?

records.jp: うわぁっ！？
records.en_original: Whoa!
records.en: Whoa!

records.jp: これって、ユズちゃんとライムちゃん……？
records.en_original: Could that be Yuzu and Lime...?
records.en: Could that be Yuzu-chan and Lime-chan...?

records.jp: ユズたちは、<CR>ヒナちゃんに伝えなきゃいけないことがある
records.en_original: We have something that we must tell Hina.
records.en: We have something that we must tell Hina-chan.

records.jp: 伝えなきゃいけないこと……？
records.en_original: Something you have to tell me...?
records.en: Something you have to tell me...?

records.jp: ごめんね、時間がないの。手短に説明するね
records.en_original: Sorry, but we don't have much time. We'll explain quickly.
records.en: Sorry, but we don't have much time. We'll explain quickly.

records.jp: まず初めに……ヒナちゃんの大切な思い出に<CR>カギをかけちゃってごめん
records.en_original: First... We're sorry that we had to keep your important memories locked up, Hina.
records.en: First... We're sorry that we had to keep your important memories locked up, Hina-chan.

records.jp: でも、世界を存続させるためには、<CR>こうするしかなかったんだ
records.en_original: But it was necessary to save the world.
records.en: But it was necessary to save the world.

records.jp: 存続……？
records.en_original: To save the world...?
records.en: To save the world...?

records.jp: この後、ヒナちゃんはフラグメントを開放して<CR>記憶を取り戻すことになる
records.en_original: After this, you'll get a Fragment, and your memory will return.
records.en: After this, you'll release the Fragment and regain your memories, Hina-chan.

records.jp: その後、学校に戻ると……異変が起こるはず
records.en_original: Then, when you go back to the school...something strange will occur.
records.en: Then, when you go back to the school...something strange will occur.

records.jp: 異変って何……？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: 記憶の再接続によってどんな影響が出るのかは、<CR>試してみないことには分からない
records.en_original: We won't know what kind of effect returning your memory will have until we try it.
records.en: We won't know what kind of effect returning your memory will have until we try it.

records.jp: まずはその異変を止めてほしい。その後は――
records.en_original: First, you must stop the phenomenon. Then—
records.en: First, you must stop the phenomenon. Then—

records.jp: 待って！
records.en_original: Wait!
records.en: Wait!

records.jp: 一つだけ、教えて
records.en_original: Just tell me one thing.
records.en: Just tell me one thing.

records.jp: あなたたちは……ユズと、ライムなんだよね？
records.en_original: You're...Yuzu and Lime, aren't you?
records.en: You're...Yuzu and Lime, aren't you?

records.jp: ……そうだけど、そうじゃない
records.en_original: Yes...and no.
records.en: Yes...and no.

records.jp: 今のライムたちは、<CR>いわば録音を再生しているような状況なんだ
records.en_original: The Yuzu and Lime that you are seeing now are, in a sense, recordings.
records.en: The Yuzu and Lime that you are seeing now are, in a sense, recordings.

records.jp: だから、本物のユズとライムじゃない
records.en_original: We are not the real Yuzu and Lime.
records.en: We are not the real Yuzu and Lime.

records.jp: そ、そんな……
records.en_original: No...
records.en: No...

records.jp: でも
records.en_original: But...
records.en: But...

records.jp: もう一度、出会う方法はある
records.en_original: There is a way for us to meet again.
records.en: There is a way for us to meet again.

records.jp: ほ、本当！？　教えて！！
records.en_original: R-really?! Tell me!
records.en: R-really?! Tell me!

records.jp: 学校に戻ったら、ユズを探して
records.en_original: Look for Yuzu when you return to the school.
records.en: Look for Yuzu when you return to the school.

records.jp: そして、ユズに伝えるの。<CR>私を――“ライムを助けに来た”って
records.en_original: Then tell her this: "We're here to save Lime."
records.en: Then tell her this: "We're here to save Lime."

records.jp: 助けに……？<CR>学校に、ユズがいるの……？
records.en_original: To save Lime...? Wait, Yuzu is at the school?
records.en: To save Lime...? Wait, Yuzu is at the school?

records.jp: そうだ、ずっと引っかかってたんだ――
records.en_original: That's right. It's been bugging me forever—
records.en: That's right. It's been bugging me forever—

records.jp: もしかして……ユズさんって、ユーコちゃんじゃない？
records.en_original: Could...Yuzu be Yuko?
records.en: Could...Yuzu-san be Yuko?

records.en_original: Ah...
records.en: Ah...

records.jp: 言われてみれば……
records.en_original: Now that you mention it...
records.en: Now that you mention it...

records.jp: 声が、似てるかも……！！
records.en_original: That voice—it does sound like Yuko!
records.en: That voice—it does sound like Yuko!

records.jp: いるよ、日菜子ちゃん！<CR>ユズちゃん、学校にいる！！
records.en_original: She's there, Hinako! Yuzu is at the school!
records.en: She's there, Hinako-chan! Yuzu-chan is at the school!

records.jp: ライムを助けに来た、そう伝えればいいんだね？
records.en_original: All I need to tell her is that we want to save Lime, right?
records.en: All I need to tell her is that we want to save Lime, right?

records.jp: そうすれば、また……二人に……――
records.en_original: And if I say that... You two will...
records.en: And if I say that... You two will...

records.jp: 時間はかかるかもしれない
records.en_original: It may take time.
records.en: It may take time.

records.jp: でも、きっと大丈夫
records.en_original: But it will work.
records.en: But it will work.

records.jp: また会えるよ
records.en_original: We will meet again.
records.en: We will meet again.

records.jp: さあ、ヒナちゃん。<CR>フラグメントに手を伸ばして――
records.en_original: Okay, Hina. Reach out to the Fragment.
records.en: Okay, Hina-chan. Reach out to the Fragment.

records.jp: フラグメントの再接続を確認しました。<CR>世界構築の安定性低下に注意してください
records.en_original: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.
records.en: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.

records.jp: 私たちを助けて、ヒナちゃん――――
records.en_original: Help us, Hina...
records.en: Help us, Hina-chan...

records.jp: 日菜子……
records.en_original: Hinako...
records.en: Hinako...

records.jp: ありがとう、みんな。<CR>私、記憶取り戻したよ
records.en_original: Thank you, everyone. My memory is back now.
records.en: Thank you, everyone. My memory is back now.

records.jp: うん……！
records.en_original: Yes...!
records.en: Yes...!

records.jp: ユズ、ライム……もう少しだけ、<CR>あとちょっとだけ、待っててね
records.en_original: Yuzu, Lime... Just wait a little longer, okay?
records.en: Yuzu, Lime... Just wait a little longer, okay?

records.jp: ――絶対に、会いに行くから
records.en_original: I'm coming for you. I promise.
records.en: I'm coming for you. I promise.
